title: Generators and colimits in the degree-zero supported hull
statement: Let Λ be any condensed commutative ring and X a qcqs scheme. The inverse image H of supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X [lem-sfb-supported-image-bounded-derived-generation] under the degree-zero single functor contains IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X [sk-def-sfb-constructible] and is closed under short exact extensions, all small filtered colimits, and all small coproducts, indexed in universe u+1. This does not assert closure under kernels or cokernels and uses neither Noetherianity nor coefficient restrictions.

proof.text: A short exact sequence gives a distinguished single-complex triangle, hence extension closure in each admissible class. Strict degree-zero complexes have common lower bound zero and their functor preserves colimits; apply the strict filtered-colimit clause. A small coproduct is the filtered colimit of finite partial biproducts. Finite sums follow from extension closure and zero. Intersect these statements over all admissible classes.

theorem supportedGeneration_heart_colimits
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] :
    let H := (supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X).inverseImage
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0)
    IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X ≤ H ∧
      H.IsClosedUnderExtensions ∧
      (∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I],
        H.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape I) ∧
      ∀ I : Type (u + 1), H.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
